items.title: Religi-comedies
items.description:
Religi-comedy shows

These are hilarious shows that tie into religion but probably aren't for religious viewers.

1 is GCB (2012) ie Good Christian B!tches  / Belles
2 is Impastor (2015-16) a slacker steals the identify of gay pastor
